All branches are advised that the following terms and conditions shall apply to Fixed Deposits (FDs) accepted on
or after 01 April 2025. This circular supersedes Circular FD/2023/09 dated 15 September 2023.
1. Eligibility
Fixed Deposits may be opened by resident individuals (singly or jointly, up to three holders), minors through a
natural or legal guardian, sole proprietorship firms, partnership firms, companies, trusts and registered societies.

In partial modification of Circular FD/2025/04 dated 01 April 2025, the Asset Liability Committee (ALCO) has

citizens. Proof of age must be submitted at the time of opening or renewing the deposit.

The revised rates apply to fresh deposits and to renewals of maturing deposits on or after 01 March 2026.
Existing deposits will continue to earn the contracted rate until maturity.

Pledged securities are valued daily at the previous trading day's closing price (net asset value for mutual funds).

securities without further notice.
